window.note: start "about G a. m." is the OCR of 6 a. m.; the end prints "13 o'clock" in this scan, which cannot be a clock time: two other archive.org scans read 12 (fence-1 close-out), so the end is 12:00; the DMNA night-of-1-2-July start is carried as a conflict

place.text: Culp's Hill, on the right of the First Corps, Rock Creek in front

quote: we began to intrench ourselves and throw up breastworks of the covering height, of logs, cord-wood, stones, and earth. The same was done by the troops on my right. By 13 o'clock we had a good cover for the men.
context_quote: we took position at about G a. m. on the right of the First Corps

conflicts.note: start of the work: about 06:00 here; the night of 1-2 July per the 60th NY monument address (DMNA); about 04:00 per the 149th NY (fence-1 close-out)

notes: Greene's own report. Tools (spades) and head logs are not stated here. The clip stands for the whole mix of materials; the group splits the rows by material. Seed row: second reading owed by us-12c.
